remarks: Move right into this turn-key, updated property in a prime Stamford location! The well-maintained, level yard features professionally landscaped mature plants and trees along with a flat backyard and patio for entertaining and enjoying outdoor activities. Inside you'll find a bright open concept kitchen, dining and living area. Matching stainless steel appliances, durable quartz countertops, and a large farmhouse sink are just a few of the highlights in this dream kitchen. The three upstairs bedrooms boast custom closets. The large bathroom with double sinks and granite countertops makes getting ready in the morning a breeze. Downstairs, the large family room with sliders to the outdoor patio is the perfect place to relax and unwind. A fourth bedroom, office and second bathroom round out the downstairs living space. Located in the sought after, convenient, and quiet Mid-Ridges neighborhood just minutes to dining, shopping, and the Merritt Parkway for easy commuting.
